summary: Hua Hong Grace reported record Q2 revenue of $717.5M, up 26.8% YoY; net profit surged to $30.6M from prior-year loss; stock rose 3.08% to $147.2
Gross margin expanded to 16.5% from 10.9% YoY on stronger pricing and cost control; fab utilization remained near 100% amid tight supply in MCU and memory
Q3 revenue guidance set at $770M-$780M with gross margin of 16%-18%; pricing strength expected to continue through H2 2026 and into 2027
Company advancing aggressive expansion with Fab 9A reaching full capacity in Q3, Fab 9B targeting Q1 2027 production; capex totaled $356.6M in quarter
Hua Li Microelectronics acquisition received final regulatory approval, expected to close within one month with Q3 consolidation to strengthen technology base
